chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed real-time Grade-R engineering card after synthetic-only parser preparation and a distinct run approval; there is no fitting, fold selection, backtest, ROI, or model comparison.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only the newest DI history row with normalized source date strictly less than 2026-08-08 may populate previous-race features.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A race whose original cutoff has passed before persistence is retained as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.quote_clock: Frozen candidate first; then exact-pair quote handling under the unchanged strict contract.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real DI parsing output, inference, quote, result, payout, or ROI operation is allowed during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE. Synthetic fixtures only.

proposal_scope.hypothesis: The fixed DI260808 HTML already contains the latest pre-target prior-race row for every experienced runner, and mapping that row into the 24 baseline-required previous-race columns is sufficient for the unchanged frozen Grade-R candidate pipeline to pass baseline inference.
in_scope: Add one deterministic parser for the newest strictly pre-2026-08-08 history row inside each fixed DI horse block
Add the 24 existing baseline-required previous-race columns to every imported runner row, leaving explicit blanks for true debut or no-history runners
After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, execute the unchanged fixed-card shadow command once and retain all late or unsupported races as terminal no-bet rows
Bind each history row to the same horse name and blood-registration identity when present and reject mismatches
Create an EXP020 successor config and fixed target manifests without changing model, feature definitions, calibrator, candidate, confidence, value, or tie-break logic
During APPROVED_TO_PREPARE run synthetic fixtures only, including no-history, latest-row selection, same-day rejection, identity mismatch, malformed table, and market-firewall cases
Keep formal_buy false, send_order false, stake zero, dashboard mutation false, notification false, credential access false, and order imports disabled
lineage_hash_requirements: Each experienced runner maps exactly one newest prior row; each no-history runner is explicit and still receives all 24 schema columns
Each mapped history row comes from the same fixed DI horse block and has a normalized race date strictly before 2026-08-08
Every Top3-set and derived WIDE distribution passes mass, finite, range, support, and duplicate checks
Every candidate-ready row is persisted before its original cutoff; every late or unsupported row fails closed
Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
Horse name and blood-registration identity are checked whenever both the current DU identity and history row identity are available
The source HTM, DU, DR, three target manifests, fold manifest, inference bundle, feature schema, model artifact, and history inputs remain hash-bound
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The DI history rows cannot be mapped without identity, time, or schema violations; the required columns remain incomplete; or an additional model, feature, threshold, candidate, market, or production change is required.
out_of_scope: Any alternative pair, ticket type, race, or stake search after observing a quote

Any historical backtest, outer OOS comparison, ROI calculation, or action-policy optimization
Any new predictive feature, feature transformation, imputation policy, model training, refit, calibration change, confidence threshold change, value threshold search, or candidate reranking
Any odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative in candidate generation, ranking, confidence, tie-break, or abstention
Any production dashboard mutation, notification, credential, purchase adapter, TARGET handoff, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any retrospective candidate freeze, missed-cutoff repair, or promotion of an expired race
Any support for obstacle races or domains outside flat turf and flat dirt

primary_metric.baseline: EXP019 imported all 462 runners and 36 races but baseline prediction failed because all 24 required previous-race columns were absent.
primary_metric.evaluation: All 24 columns exist for all 462 rows; 420 experienced runners select exactly one newest pre-target history row; 42 no-history runners are explicit; then the unchanged command represents all 36 targets while accepting only still-on-time flat races.
primary_metric.name: previous_race_schema_and_candidate_terminal_completeness

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No row dated 2026-08-08 or later may enter target features.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may influence candidate selection, confidence, tie-break, or abstention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No missed candidate cutoff or strict quote cutoff may be repaired with later information.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 race identities and 462 runners remain fixed independently of market and results.

proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The frozen model requires each runner's latest historical performance context. DI260808 contains those pre-race observations inside each horse block, but the multicard adapter currently retains only the current runner identity and discards the history table. This experiment restores existing model inputs without changing their definitions or the model policy.
